newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM to raise Sept rubber futures margin fees.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM to raise Sept rubber futures margin fees.

text.p: The Tokyo Commodity Exchange (TOCOM) said on Tuesday that it would raise the margin requirements on its September rubber futures contract by 20,000 yen per trading lot, effective from Wednesday.
The hike will bring the September requirement to 127,750 yen, a TOCOM statement said.
The increase is intended to cool overheated trade.
The margin requirements on other rubber futures contracts will remain unchanged at 52,500 yen, it said.
